text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the Japanese Derby rapidly
approaching,
the wave of hype is about
to crest...

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
Although an injury kept her from
competing in
the Satsuki Sho, she put on
a performance worthy
of a junior
champion last year, and she might just

steal the show at this year's Derby...

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
Continuing on, Yaeno Muteki is
considered to be
the next best
contender, considering how
splendidly
she performed at the Satsuki Sho...

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
But let's not forget about Sakura
Chiyono O,
whose running at the Asahi
Hai left a lasting
impression. Having
maintained a consistent
running form
since last year, her chances of
victory
are equally strong.

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
Will Mejiro Ardan be able to outshine
her sister
Ramonu? This is yet another
major point of
discussion...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The mass media is rife with the opinion
that last
year's junior champion is most
likely to win the
Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Honestly though, I'm not entirely
convinced this
consensus is warranted.
The reason being...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've seen—firsthand—alarming
improvements in
both Yaeno Muteki and
Sakura Chiyono O since
they started
their classic year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although, funnily enough... I could say
the same
of Mejiro Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So, from my perspective, I expect Mejiro
Ardan's
greatest rivals for the moment
will be Sakura
Chiyono O and Yaeno
Muteki.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With this strange thought occurring to
me, I leave
my office and head off to
meet Mejiro Ardan for
training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That evening...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... Pant!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan is pushing herself with a
passion
unlike anything I've seen in her
before.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...I'm not done yet. One more!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I know she's very eager, what with the
Derby
coming up, but she hasn't been
herself recently.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She always runs like there's no
tomorrow, but...
I'm sensing a kind of
desperation in her right now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, please let me run a few more
laps. I can
handle it, so—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan suddenly loses balance—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But I manage to catch her right before
she hits
the ground!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Trainer... I'm terribly sorry...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I can ignore this. If she
keeps up
this intensity, it won't just be
the Japanese Derby
she has to say
goodbye to, it'll be her entire
racing
career!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I wish to surpass my limits.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...I shan't back down.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I don't wish to be held back by words like limits!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: If I don't surpass who I am now... If I can't do that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Then... how can I hope to win the
Japanese
Derby?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...I won't stand a chance of outshining
my older
sister!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
After the Aoba Sho, I realized
something.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I realized that I have a great fear in my

heart—one I cannot dismiss...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
No, it's rather that... I have an
unwavering belief.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I know how Chiyono O feels about the
Japanese
Derby.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
And I know that the yearning she
harbors is pure
and sincere, and as
vibrant with color as a cherry
blossom in
full bloom.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I know how Yaeno seeks strong
competition.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
And I know that beneath her tranquil
exterior, she
houses a warrior's spirit as
ferocious as fire.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
They've been so kind to me all this time,
and in
that time I've come to know their
feelings.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
They are my dearest friends... and they
are
irreplaceable.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
And that is precisely why I can't help
being
certain.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Certain that they will be there at the Japanese Derby, harboring those feelings and dazzling with incomparable light.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
And that if I were to race them in their
current
condition, without having
improved myself since
the Aoba Sho, I'd
not be able to win.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
And I'd have no hope of surpassing my
older
sister's brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...The source of these thoughts is
something akin
to intuition. I wouldn't
mind if you dismissed all
I've said as
drivel, but I—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan has an accurate grasp of
the
difference in running ability between
herself and
her rivals. She knows better
than I do how they
compare. This, I'm
sure of.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And that's because...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...I know Ardan has her doubts, but I
believe in
her.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I have faith that she'll ace her debut and
be able
to race together with Yaeno and
me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I have an inkling myself of just how
profound her
feelings about racing are.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
But it's not like I'm any less committed
myself!
That's why, when we eventually
compete
someday, I'm going to race
with all I've got!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Especially for the Japanese Derby...
There's no
way I'm letting anybody else
win that!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O has that same faith in
Mejiro
Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And just as Sakura Chiyono O said,
Mejiro Ardan
is currently fighting for a
chance to race against
her and Yaeno
Muteki in the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though I haven't asked Yaeno Muteki
directly, I
bet she believes in Ardan the
same way. That's
how strong the bonds
between those three are.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And if the Japanese Derby has helped
Mejiro
Ardan realize what kind of
connection they share,
it must be a very
special race—and one that'll
play host to
a real clash of wills.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To ensure that Mejiro Ardan wins, that
she steps
out from her legendary older
sister's shadow, and
that she realizes her
dreams...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the time we have left, I'm going to
train Mejiro
Ardan as much as possible,
then see her enter the
Japanese Derby
in full health.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she's going to push her legs and her
dazzling
light to the extreme, then I'll
need to commit my
full attention to
finding out what the extreme
looks like.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That is my resolve as a trainer. And as the trainer who made a vow to Mejiro Ardan's nanny and her physician, it's also my duty.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
You always try your best... to see things
the same
way I do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...And for that, I am forever grateful.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Sure!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I shall take the time I have left before
the
Japanese Derby... and turn every
moment of it
into my light.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
To you, who shines down from so high... I
shall
outshine you with my own dazzling
light.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: At the Japanese Derby...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: To realize my hopes, and my dreams...

text_block_list.name: All Three
text_block_list.text: ...I'm going to win!
